title: payment-api slowed over the afternoon with rising RSS
symptoms: latency growing in step with memory, not with a sudden traffic spike
callers seeing timeouts and 5xx once the process was under heap pressure
timeouts that could be mistaken for a slow dependency
occasional allocation failures or container restarts late in the incident
observed_signals: after a restart, memory dropped and then began climbing again
memory_usage rose smoothly over a long period rather than in a single jump
CPU increased only moderately until GC became frequent

timeline.event: memory_usage on payment-api began a near-linear climb
GC / heap warnings became frequent on payment-api
error-rate or latency alert fired on payment-api
restart or rollback dropped RSS; latency followed

contributing_factors: a library upgrade retained event listeners
no SLO existed on RSS slope
resolution: rolled back the library version that retained listeners
captured a heap dump before the second restart
added a slow memory-growth monitor (15-minute slope)
lessons_learned: heap dumps need to be taken before the second crash
a restart that restores latency is mitigation, not a fix
